title: Add negative coverage that restricted readiness-deferred drains do not register ordinary activation
outcome: Restricted queue-drain origins retain their existing custody when readiness defers them; tests catch accidental conversion into ordinary activation.
acceptance: A focused regression covers applicable allow-blocked, orphaned-workflow and specialised-owner readiness-defer paths, and asserts the existing ordinary activation field is unchanged.
The positive ordinary-wake registration and existing restriction/owner assertions remain intact; no production behavior or timeout is weakened.
disposal_reason: Fable2722 obsolete-feature sweep: completed parent w3af0 blocks claim; tracker-advertised independence is used only for removal-provenance disposition, not renewed gated-control implementation.
